form.label: User Investigator
form.description: Deep dive a team/user for the selected CTF.

search.query: | inputlookup ctf_registrations | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" status="registered" | where Team!="" | dedup Team | sort Team
| search Team="$team$" | stats dc(Number) as numquestions
| search Team="$team$" | stats earliest(_time) as first latest(_time) as last | eval minutes=round((last-first)/60,0) | fields minutes
| inputlookup currentscore.csv | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" Team="$team$" | stats max(Score) as Score
| inputlookup currentscore.csv | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" Team="$team$" | stats max(Rank) as Rank
| search Team="$team$" | eval ScoreImpact=BasePointsAwarded+SpeedBonusAwarded+AdditionalBonusAwarded-Penalty | table _time Number QuestionOfficial Answer user Result ScoreImpact | sort - _time
